_what: Rollup for whiteheadka_30637934 -> Experiment_ID KW_2019. Every entry is a measured number. Each check was run clean AND with a defect seeded; 07_seeded_checks.json holds both readings and a check is credited only where the AGREEMENT COUNT MOVED.

paper.title: Branched-Tail Lipid Nanoparticles Potently Deliver mRNA In Vivo due to Enhanced Ionization at Endosomal pH.
paper.title_and_endpoint_verified_from: Europe PMC REST core record, SRC:MED EXT_ID:30637934, 2026-11-10
paper.endpoint: mRNA delivery / transfection. Emitted endpoint: in vitro firefly-luciferase activity in HeLa, RLU, 100 ng mRNA per well, 24 h, n=4.
paper.id_collision_check: KW_2014 exists in the corpus (Whitehead 2014); KW_2019 does not. The staged sibling whiteheadka_38888972 uses KW_2024, so the lab key is consistent.

extraction_tier.why_not_tier_1_2_3: No Source Data file (Wiley, isOpenAccess=N, hasSuppl=N, availabilityCode S); no SI numeric table carries a delivery value; find_repo.py returned 0 relevant hits and NCBI esearch db=pmc on the DOI returns Count=0.

three_counts_that_differ._what: Distinct structures, formulations, and individually measured values are three different numbers and this paper separates them cleanly.
three_counts_that_differ.distinct_structures_in_the_whole_library: NOT DETERMINABLE from what we hold. The SI Methods name THREE amines (200, 304, 306) and the abstract names 'a small library' plus 'a secondary lipidoid library', but every value-bearing table and figure in the SI is 306-family only and the main text is behind a subscription. So the library is larger than 11 by an unknown factor and no value for a 200- or 304-amine lipidoid is recoverable.
three_counts_that_differ.formulation_detail: One formulation for the whole screen: 35 : 16 : 46.5 : 2.5 mol%, 10:1 w/w lipidoid:mRNA. No formulation variable is screened anywhere in this paper.
three_counts_that_differ.in_vivo_values_resolved_per_lipidoid: Figure S3D: 3 lipidoids x a time course. Figure S4: 2 lipidoids x 3 doses, as a six-organ STACKED total. Figure S5: 2 lipidoids x 3 timepoints, EPO protein not luciferase. None digitised; see DECISIONS.md D-2.

structures.built_via: curation/lib assemble.esterify for the ester bond and assemble.attach on atom-mapped attachment atoms for all four N-C bonds; no RemoveAtom anywhere near a stereocentre, no string surgery.
structures.stereocentres_note: The 306 core is achiral and 8-methylnonyl's branch carbon bears two identical methyls, so no structure here has a stereocentre and assemble's stereo assertions are vacuous rather than passing. Stated so the clean line is not read as evidence.

check_mass_ladder._what: Each consecutive linear-tail step must add exactly 4 x dC x CH2, because the lipidoid has four arms. A relation among the authors' name tokens and our masses that the paper never prints.

check_abstract_mass_identity.claim: abstract: 306O10 and 306Oi10 have ten-carbon tails and identical molecular weights

check_two_pKa_conventions_DO_NOT_POOL._what: Table S2 is the LIPIDOID pKa in ethanol; Table S1 is the LNP SURFACE pKa in aqueous buffer by TNS. Different material, different solvent, different method. This is reported as a SPREAD, not as a disagreement to fix.

check_mole_percents_sum_to_100._what: The SI prints 'a molar ratio of 35 : 16 : 46.5 : 2.5' for four components. The sum is a round number the authors never printed, and it confirms these are mol% with no fifth component unaccounted for. WHICH component takes 16 and which takes 46.5 is a separate question and is DECISIONS.md D-1.

geometry_panelA.label_offset_spread_caveat: 0.002 pt across 11 labels is the striking number but it does NOT pin the assignment: rotating the category list leaves it unchanged. The absolute nearest-tick test does pin it and scores 11/11 clean, 0/11 seeded. See 08_contradictions.csv X-8.
geometry_panelA.width_discriminator_note: Bar, whisker cap and marker separate by EXACT width, not by a coverage threshold, so error class 32 (F-018, F-020: a replicate marker read as a bar top) is closed by construction. curation/lib bars.py is not called because it takes an ink array and no raster exists.
geometry_panelA.frame_choice: bar OUTLINE, whose legs start exactly on the y=0 tick at 220.45 pt, so bar tops and ticks share one coordinate system and no origin is supplied separately (error class 20 / F-033).

geometry_panelB.dose_monotonicity_note: 4/4 lipidoids increase across 10 < 50 < 100 ng. This also validates the legend colour -> dose mapping: the seeded swap of two legend swatches drops it to 0/4.

CROSS_PANEL_DISAGREEMENT._what: Both panels are HeLa / firefly-luciferase / RLU / 24 h, and S6A's single dose IS 100 ng, so S6B's 100 ng series must reproduce S6A on these four lipidoids. It does not: see 08_contradictions.csv. Neither panel is averaged into the other and neither is adjusted by the other.

corpus_overlap.attestation: KW_2014 stores five of these structures under 'A306_C<n>' names and NC_2024 stores six under 'A306_O<n>' names; all six of ours that match do so by FULL InChIKey with canonically identical SMILES, and zero of the eleven have a name match with a structure mismatch. Since this paper prints no HRMS, no formula, no MW and draws no structure, this is its ONLY external structure anchor besides the reagent names themselves.

emitted_rows.dialysis_buffer_blank_because: SI Methods p.2 dialyses only the in-vivo LNPs ('For in vivo experiments, the LNPs were dialyzed against PBS'); the in-vitro LNPs were diluted into PBS and used. Blank is 'not stated to have happened', not 'clean'.
emitted_rows.excipients_resolved_by: curation/lib reagents.smi, which RAISED on DMPE-PEG2000 (two structures in the corpus) and resolved DOPE, Cholesterol and C14-PEG2000 uniquely. See 08_contradictions.csv X-10.

C10_anchor.derived_from: the SI Methods reagent NAMES (p.2), typed as source string literals, head-first traversal
C10_anchor.independence_established_by: PROVENANCE, not byte difference (F-037). make_reference.py's assert_no_assembler() walks its own AST at run time and confirms it imports no assembler module and calls none of RWMol, AddBond, RemoveAtom, CombineMols, EditableMol, ReactionFromSmarts, RunReactants, esterify, attach.
C10_anchor.move_an_ester_note: identical molecular formula and identical exact mass to every decimal place, so the gate demonstrably tests connectivity and not mass.
C10_anchor.first_version_of_assert_no_assembler_cou: it substring-scanned a file that contains its own blocklist and reported all eight forbidden tokens on a clean run. Replaced with AST inspection. A check that cannot pass is as useless as one that cannot fail.

seeded_checks.rule: credited only where the agreement count MOVED; a seed that merely raises proves the code has an exception, not that the check discriminates.

open_decisions: D-3 Figure S6B as a separate experiment
